meta.title: MARBLE Mountains VIETNAM I Da Nang Day ONE I  Complete TRAVEL Guide
meta.description:
#vietnam #vietnamtravel #vietnam2023 #vietjetair #indiatovietnam #thingstoknow 

Welcome to CENTRAL VIETNAM!
In this video, we take you to the majestic Marble Mountains of Vietnam which is a must visit attraction in Da Nang. Situated within the city, these mountains offer a panoramic view of the city. We share with you options to reach the top and a slight glimpse of different caves present there. Buddhist caves draw your attention and give you a serene atmosphere full of calmness and spirituality. 
Hope you like the video! Stay tuned for updates.
